question: Conditional on the O2.6 two-identity/one-new-dimension solution, how many target-imagery repeats T per identity are required to estimate the missing target-state axis well enough to generalize to unseen imagery identities?
conditional_claim_boundary: conditioned on the O2.6 M=2,D=1 resource point under the tested representation; does NOT prove 2 identities / 1 direction / 2 trials universally sufficient, nor biological/causal

fixed_resource_point.identity_pairs: all 25 balanced (1 simple + 1 nat) per outer fold

trial_state_extension.requires: individual imagery-trial native residuals delta_trial(i,t) for subject x ROI x fold x outer-training identity x repeat 0..7
trial_state_extension.definition: delta_trial = delta_perp(y_trial, B_vis, mu_vis) with the frozen outer-fold vision span; same B0 lineage / voxels / mu_vis / residual def / scaling; no new preprocessing or trial normalization
trial_state_extension.repeat_index: 0..7 in original within-identity acquisition order (do not reorder by quality)

trial_replay_cert.delta8: mean_{t=0..7} delta_trial(i,t) must reproduce sealed O2.6 identity-level delta_native(i) <= 1e-10
trial_replay_cert.test_replay: 8-mean of the 2 outer-test identities must reproduce sealed deltas_test <= 1e-10; voxel hashes identical

t8_replay.run_before_T_lt_8: M2,D1,T8 with trial-level state must exactly replay sealed O2.6 M2,D1 frontier (pairs/P_IN/outside basis/R_BASE/R_AUG/TOTAL/participant) <= 1e-10

limited_repeat.delta_i(S): mean_{t in S} delta_trial(i,t) (no extra centering)
limited_repeat.Z_i(S): W_target.T @ delta_i(S) (T-limited; do NOT use full-repeat Z for T<8)
limited_repeat.b_T: first left singular vector of [delta_out_1(S), delta_out_2(S)] (D=1), deterministic sign; ||b_T||~1, ||W_target.T b_T||<=1e-10

evaluation.on: SEALED full-8-repeat held-out target residual centroids (deltas_test); test target fixed while calibration measurement quality reduced -> isolates calibration sample complexity

null.replace: b_T with one matched random outside-col(W_target) direction: g~N(0,I) -> g - W(W.T g) -> normalize

axis_fidelity.AXIS_FIDELITY(T): |b_T.T b_8|^2 (sign-invariant), b_8 = full-repeat T=8 direction for the same subject/ROI/fold/pair

program_status.MINIMAL_TARGET_STATE_CALIBRATION_FOUR_TO: both T_STAR<=2 and >=1 ROI requires T=2
program_status.TARGET_STATE_TRIAL_CALIBRATION_MULTIREGI: primary ROIs differ so no common reduced-repeat budget
program_status.REDUCED_TRIAL_TARGET_STATE_CALIBRATION_N: required primary reduced-repeat success not reached

repeat_reliability.per_identity: all balanced 4-vs-4 splits of the 8 trial outside residuals -> two split-half outside directions -> squared cosine; participant-first median; no threshold on T_STAR

generalization_control.overfit: if calibration rises but held-out poor -> LOW_REPEAT_TARGET_STATE_OVERFIT_SIGNATURE (document; do not modify model)

repeat_position_diagnostic.report: performance across early/middle/late repeat positions; no best-repeat selection; no threshold

trial_time_accounting.duration: report cue/imagery/response/ITI/total per-trial only if exactly derivable from Dataset-1 metadata; else exact trial count + descriptive original-run timing; do NOT invent minutes

next_gate.both_T_STAR_le_2: O2.8 TARGET-STATE BASIS COMPOSITION AND CROSS-SUBJECT SHAREDNESS (is the 1-D missing axis related across participants or subject-specific?)
next_gate.T_STAR_4_or_not_established: O2.8 TARGET-STATE AXIS RELIABILITY / NOISE DECOMPOSITION (is the remaining burden measurement noise vs representational complexity?)
